messages:
lina: FYI starting a terraform apply to bump gpu nodepool min/desired in eu-west-1 for perf tests. Plan shows replacements in az-b and az-c rather than scale up. Suspect subnet CIDR overlap + ip exhaustion. Pausing now.
omar: Can you paste the plan output? Which resource is being replaced?
lina: snippet from plan:
```
-/+ aws_autoscaling_group.cluster-gpu (new resource required)
  ~ subnet_ids: [subnet-aaa, subnet-bbb, subnet-ccc] -> [subnet-aaa, subnet-ddd, subnet-ccc]
  ~ availability_zones: [eu-west-1a, eu-west-1b] -> [eu-west-1a, eu-west-1c]
```
lina: Also saw this in controller logs after nodes reprovisioned locally: `failed to attach eni: attachment would exceed limit`
devops-bot: Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/infra/eni-limits — recommend check subnet / AZ allocations and cloud-provider quotas.
matt: Did the subnet-ddd come from the new cluster module change (split-subnets)? I updated the gitops branch last week to avoid AZ pinning.
omar: That matches. We moved from per-AZ explicit to CIDR pool allocator so terraform may pick different AZs when replacing instances. But if subnets are smaller it can hit IP limits.
lina: TL;DR: Terraform wants to replace nodes into a different subnet with lower available IPs -> nodes fail to attach ENIs. I canceled apply to avoid evicting workloads.
sre-oncall: For immediate mitigation: scale down GPU-nodepool desired count to current and create new nodepool with explicit subnet mapping, or increase subnet CIDR. Which is faster?
matt: Creating a new nodepool with explicit subnets is quicker and safer for canary. I can push a gitops change to add an explicit nodepool manifest.
omar: If we do that, ensure taints/labels match and autoscaler config points to the new ASG. Also update Terraform state import if needed.
lina: I'll open a small PR to pin subnets for the rollout and add a preflight check in pipeline to fail if available IPs < desired*2.
devops-bot: CI check idea: `aws ec2 describe-subnets --subnet-ids $IDS --query 'Subnet[].AvailableIpAddressCount'` in pre-apply hook.
sre-oncall: Also file for follow-up: review CIDR plan for eu-west-1, consider /20 instead of /24 for gpu subnets.
lina: Creating the PR and a short runbook note. @matt can you sketch the new nodepool manifest?
matt: On it, will post in here when done. :thumbsup:
